Method of Attack: Deploys a CoinMiner executable on Linux devices
Hides payload in init.py file hosted on a remote URL
Decodes and retrieves a shell script named 'unmi.sh' to fetch configuration file and CoinMiner executable
Introduces malicious commands into ~/.bashrc file for persistence
Attack Vector: Remote URL hosting payload in init.py file
Shell script 'unmi.sh' fetching additional malicious components
Indicators of Compromise: Configuration file and CoinMiner executable hosted on GitLab
